The dashboard is the box\'s REST API core (dash-node) — a small Node service on 127.0.0.1:4000, fronted by nginx and supervised by pdsm. It powers every in-app library action: browsing and downloading Books, adding and deleting Wikipedia and ZIM content, Kolibri sessions, Maps, and system status. Unlike the content modules, you can\'t install or remove it. It ships with the app and is always present. When a newer build is available you can rebuild it in place.
Books, Wikipedia/ZIM, Kolibri and Maps REST endpoints; the nginx vhost; and system version + rebuild endpoints — all served on 127.0.0.1:4000.
